# NEED SME REVIEW
## Inpatient
### ORZID2 GMENU SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
#### SEPSIS OR SHOCK WITH SUSPECTED URINARY TRACT INFECTION
Consider empirical broad-spectrum antimicrobials and consulting Infectious
Diseases if urinary tract infection is not strongly suspected as the main source
of infection. Refer to Unclear Infectious Source for recommendations.
[Unclear Infectious Source](sepsis-empiric-therapy-site-unk)
#### Patients on general medical wards
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] for 7 days
#### Patients in the ICU or with a history of Pseudomonas
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R] for 7 days
< OR >
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] for 7 days
< OR >
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R,DI] for 5 days
#### History of ESBL isolate
Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h [R,O] for 7 days
#### History of MRSA, add to intravenous therapy above
<ADD> Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] for 7 days
## ER/UC
### ORZID GMENU ER/UC SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
#### SEVERE SEPSIS OR SHOCK WITH SUSPECTED URINARY TRACT INFECTION
Consider empirical broad-spectrum antimicrobials and consulting Infectious
Diseases if urinary tract infection is not strongly suspected as the main source
of infection. Refer to Unclear Infectious Source for recommendations.
[Unclear Infectious Source](sepsis-empiric-therapy-site-unk)
#### Patients transferring to general medical wards
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV ONCE STAT [M]
#### Patients transferring to the ICU or with a history of Pseudomonas
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV ONCE STAT [R]
< OR >
Cefepime 2 gm IV ONCE STAT [R]
< OR >
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV ONCE STAT [R,DI]
#### History of ESBL isolate
Meropenem 1 gm IV ONCE STAT [R,O]
#### History of MRSA, add to intravenous therapy above
<ADD> Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV ONCE STAT [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
